items.title: Autodesk Advances Agentic AI in Its Three Industry Clouds
items.excerpt: Autodesk previewed next-generation Autodesk Assistant capabilities spanning Fusion, Forma and Flow. The system is intended to use project context plus specialized design, engineering, simulation and manufacturing tools; broader cross-product rollout is planned to begin in 2027.

items.title: Autodesk Fusion Compute MCP: Public Beta
items.excerpt: Autodesk opened a public beta of Fusion Compute MCP, a cloud-hosted MCP server exposing Fusion to AI agents through more than 7,000 TypeScript API endpoints. Agents can create parametric geometry, assemblies, CAM toolpaths, posted NC code, exports and multiple parallel Fusion sessions.

items.title: Autodesk Fusion Brings AI Deeper into Connected Design and Manufacturing Workflows
items.excerpt: Autodesk detailed new Fusion AI capabilities covering design-history reconstruction, assembly creation, product configuration, CAM programming, part discovery and design reuse. AutoTimeline uses AI feature recognition to reconstruct editable parametric history from history-less geometry.

items.title: September 2026 Major Product Update – What’s New
items.excerpt: Fusion's September release added native PMI creation/editing, downstream PMI use in machining and inspection, expanded modeling APIs and process-simulation automation. Autodesk also reports a mesh-assisted Boolean fallback that recovered over 60% of previously failing Boolean operations in its testing.

items.title: System-Level Modeling and Agentic AI Take the Spotlight in COMSOL Multiphysics Version 2027
items.excerpt: COMSOL announced Multiphysics 2027 with COMSOL Systems for system-level models coupled to 1D/2D/3D multiphysics, an MCP Server for external AI agents, and a new Electric Motor Module. Agents can build or modify models, run simulations, inspect results and iterate through the COMSOL API.
items.query: site:comsol.com 2026 September COMSOL simulation CFD multiphysics news release

items.title: Featured Speakers Announced for the COMSOL Conference 2026 Boston
items.excerpt: COMSOL announced an October conference program with a panel on scaling AI-ready multiphysics workflows and sessions involving NASA Ames, MIT, Intel, GM, Formula E and Cosmon. The program explicitly highlights AI-assisted modeling and agentic simulation workflows across engineering domains.

items.title: Component Validation During Operation – Siemens Energy Tests New Gas Turbine Technologies at German Chemical Park
items.category: ガスタービン・技術サービス
items.excerpt: A Siemens Energy SGT-800 industrial demonstrator was commissioned at Marl Chemical Park for four years of commercial-operation validation. The program targets blades, vanes, burners, additive-manufactured parts, advanced materials and coatings, with continuous monitoring over thousands of hours.

items.title: Agente de IA para agilizar tareas de modelización en COMSOL Multiphysics
items.excerpt: Addlink described Cosmon's Nexus agent working alongside COMSOL to automate CAD geometry cleanup, simulation setup, parametric sweeps, solver-error handling and report generation. Cosmon is outside the mandatory watchlist and merits continued monitoring as an engineering-agent/simulation startup.
